integrity: All analytic and finite classification checks are same-model only; independent audit not performed. Source papers are credited and no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite unweighted habitat trees, homogeneous independent survival, one perfectly protected patch, and full surviving-set connectivity; no general graph, unequal survival, many-site, or empirical conclusion. Bibliographic coverage is incomplete for one 1993 algorithm source.
title: Seven habitat patches are sharp for reliability-dependent protection-site switches
